author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 12 volume 1 chapters 4-5 follow the 2023 science textbook: rational functions (oblique asymptote, quadratic over quadratic, applications), the number e, exponential derivatives and applications, natural logarithm properties, equations and systems, ln-function study and applications, vector operations in space, distance and direction cosines, moment of a force, triple product and the sphere; chapter exams are chapter-level.
